entities.summary: Gerald Alexander Fleming is a Canadian former professional ice hockey forward who played 11 games in the National Hockey League for the Montreal Canadiens during the 1993–94 and 1994–95 seasons. Fleming also played ice hockey for the University of Prince Edward Island Panthers and the Fredericton Canadiens in the American Hockey League during his career, which lasted from 1991 to 1998.
